title: Hotbar Shuffler
description: A mod that makes build texturing easier
body:
This mod helps add texture and variation to your builds by randomizing the placeable blocks in your hotbar, creating fun patterns that don’t look too repetitive or standardized. All you have to do is enable it by pressing R (Default Keybind) and start placing blocks!
